changelog: **The mentee sees their own completion certificate in the portal and can add it to LinkedIn.** `/portal/journey` gets a "Your certificate" card (`src/components/PortalCertificateCard.tsx`) that renders only when the relation is certificate-eligible by the same `canIssueCertificate` rule the generate route uses, and is gated on the `mentorship` capability (internship product only). Until a certificate is issued it says so and offers nothing to click; once one is, it shows the printed title, the issuer (the tenant branding name the PDF prints) and the issue date, a download through the existing `GET /api/documents/[id]` (which already answered the owner and refused other mentees with 403 — no route was widened; generating stays mentor/admin-only, #813), and an "Add to LinkedIn profile" link to LinkedIn's official `profile/add?startTask=CERTIFICATION_NAME` URL with name, `organizationName`, `issueYear` and `issueMonth` (UTC), opened in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. No `certUrl`/`certId` and no public verification page: publishing a certificate URL is a separate consent question. The rule (`src/lib/certificateLinkedIn.ts`, dependency-free, unit-tested, coverage floor 95) counts only a certificate actually issued — a CERTIFICATE document owned by the mentee, uploaded by someone else, titled with the certificate variant's title — so a self-uploaded file or a reference letter never reaches LinkedIn. A certificate counts for the card only when it was generated on or after the relation's `startDate` (a certificate stores no relation id, so an earlier programme's PDF is never shown as this one's), and every issued-only condition is in the query so self-uploads cannot crowd it out. The generate route now prints the RELATION's tenant branding (was the generating user's home org — wrong for a super admin acting in another tenant), which is the same org the card reads; a brand rename after issue is accepted drift, documented in the card. Light by design: no points, badges or ranking. `e2e/portal-certificate.spec.ts` covers the pending state, the download, the LinkedIn URL, the other-mentee 403 and the MARKETING gate.

en: Your completion certificate is now in your portal: download the PDF or add it to your LinkedIn profile in one click, with the name, issuer and date already filled in.
tr: Tamamlama belgen artık portalında: PDF olarak indir ya da adı, düzenleyen kurumu ve tarihi hazır doldurulmuş şekilde tek tıkla LinkedIn profiline ekle.
de: Dein Abschlusszertifikat ist jetzt in deinem Portal: als PDF herunterladen oder mit einem Klick zu deinem LinkedIn-Profil hinzufügen – Name, Aussteller und Datum sind bereits ausgefüllt.
